record.reason: Adapting While Learning grounds LLM scientific problem solving through tool-use adaptation and evaluates reasoning/task success with tool feedback. The paper focuses on capability adaptation, not reducing inference compute, memory or latency; possible relation to test-time reasoning is indirect. Keep borderline for possible cross-reference rather than an efficiency followup.
